comment: tsx-only config: makes `pnpx tsx libs/cli/src/cli/bin.ts` (run from this dir) execute @lmthing/core from SOURCE instead of its built dist. tsx reads compilerOptions.paths + baseUrl and rewrites the bare `@lmthing/core` specifier to libs/core/src. Only core is remapped: the cli's other workspace deps (ui/css/auth/state) are imported solely in browser entries that esbuild already bundles from their own src, so they stay on their package `exports` (dist). `include: []` keeps this file inert for `tsc`/editors — each package still builds via its own tsconfig.
